CA Inter Both Groups Passed.
Sound understanding of basic accounting and taxation concepts, with a keen interest in GST and Indirect Taxes.
Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with the ability to handle data, prepare reports, and create structured documentation.

Attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a systematic approach to reviewing transactions and reconciliations.
